description: Tune how strongly an agent leans on one cognitive operation. Required: agent_id, gene_id, expression (0..1; 0 switches it off for this agent, 0.5 is neutral). Optional: reason. Changes behaviour for every future decision, so say why.

expression.description: Strength 0..1; 0 switches the operation off for this agent, 0.5 is neutral
